description.zh:
备份ID。

当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，备份ID个数与Shard节点个数相同，中间用英文逗号（,）间隔。
description.en:
The backup ID.

If you specify the ID of a sharded cluster instance for the **DBInstanceId** parameter, the number of backup IDs must be the same as the number of shard nodes. Separate the backup IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
实例ID。
> 当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入**NodeId**参数。
description.en:
The ID of the instance.

> If the instance is a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the **NodeId** parameter.

description.zh:
备份所在地域。


> 异地备份必填。
description.en:
The region where the backup resides.

> This parameter is required for geo-redundancy.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 > 当传入BackupId时，此参数无效。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> This parameter is invalid if you specify the BackupId parameter.

description.zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点的ID。

> 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数必填。
description.en:
The ID of the shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

> This parameter is required if you specify the ID of a sharded cluster instance for the **DBInstanceId** parameter.

description.zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and not greater than the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: **1**.

The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- **30** (Default)

- **50**

- **100**

description.zh:
实例所在地域。

> 
> - 已删除实例恢复必填。
> - 异地备份必填。
description.en:
The region where the instance resides.

> - This parameter is required to restore a deleted instance.
>
> - This parameter is required for geo-redundancy.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 > 当传入BackupId时，此参数无效。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

> This parameter is invalid if you specify the BackupId parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-backups --db-instance-id dds-bp1a7009eb240000 --node-id d-bp128a0034360000 --backup-id 20720000,20720000,20720000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --start-time 2022-01-13T13:00Z --end-time 2022-01-14T13:00Z --src-region cn-beijing --dest-region cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-xxxx --backup-job-id 775051 --region cn-hangzhou
